instruction: High-angle studio portrait, medium shot. Indoors against a pale background, three women pose together. The curly-haired woman in a white shirt (R1) sits in the center, looking at the camera. On the left, the straight-haired woman in a denim jacket (R2) sits leaning her head on R1's shoulder. In the foreground, the curly-haired woman in a black top (R3) lies down, resting her head on R1's lap and looking up. Soft, natural light fills the calm scene.
